main_text.l: QUIS EST TERTIUS
Titulus?
De servitutibus praediorum. Von dienst-
Duplex : personalis aut realis. Personalis, quae à
persona personae debetur, ut est in hominibus
servilis conditionis, de qua supra dictum est: vel quae
à persona rei debetur, ut quando persona cogitur
certo cuidam loco assistere: Realis est, quae à re, rei
debetur.
Duplex: Rustica aut urbana Rustica, quae rusticis
praediis debetur: Urbana, q̄ urbanis prędiis debetur.
Rustica prędia dicuntur ipsi agri vel fundi. Item
ędificia, quae sunt structa[?] pro rebus rusticis, pecori-
bus & fructibus, sive sint in urbe, sive extra urbem.
Urbana prędia dicuntur ędificia, inhabitādi gra-
tia facta, & hominum usui & habitationi destinata,
sive in urbe, sive extra urbem in rure vel villa posita
sint. Vide Schneidevvinum.
Ad hoc autem ut cognoscatur an sit servitus rusti-
ca seu urbana, inspicitur qualitas prędii dominan-
tis, cui servitus debetur: non prędii servientis, quod
servitutem debet. Unde licet via sit servitus rustica,
tamen si debetur pe fundum tuum domui meae, di-
citur urbana servitus, secundum Schneidevvinum.

page.notes: The title "QUIS EST TERTIUS" is printed large and spaced; the caput number is inferred from the word "Tertius". The German headings and gloss words are in blackletter. Line 1 of the first paragraph opens with a large D, joined to the text as "Duplex". In "Q̄ urbanis" the abbreviation mark is read as q̄ and may be doubtful. "structa" is partly obscured by ink and marked [?]. "Schneidevvinum" is printed as shown and is a printing spelling, left as is. "pe fundum" is printed so and left as is.
